blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Former two-division world champion Marlon “Nightmare” Tapales will make his much-awaited debut in the featherweight division on September 26 in Pattaya, Thailand. Sanman Promotions announced Tapales’ upcoming bout through its social media platforms. The 34-year-old Tapales, a former World Boxing Organization (WBO) bantamweight world champion and International Boxing Federation (IBF) super bantamweight world champion, is moving up from super bantamweight to the heavier and more competitive featherweight division.
